intents.name: software_bug_report
intents.description: Reports of specific software glitches, crashes, UI malfunctions, or unexpected behavior in iOS, macOS, or apps, including issues triggered by recent updates.
examples: My iPhone keeps crashing to the home screen whenever I open the Camera app.
After updating to iOS 17, my keyboard autocorrects 'i' to 'A?' every time.
The Maps app is freezing and not loading traffic data.
Siri is not responding to voice commands and the screen goes black.

intents.name: hardware_defect
intents.description: Reports of physical device malfunctions, manufacturing defects, or component failures such as screen issues, touch sensitivity problems, or device bricking.
examples: My new iPhone has a green line running down the left side of the screen.
The touch screen is unresponsive in the bottom right corner.
My MacBook Pro won't turn on at all; the power light is off.
The hinge on my iPad is loose and the screen cracks when I open it.

intents.name: battery_and_power
intents.description: Issues related to battery performance, rapid drain, overheating, charging problems, or battery health degradation.
examples: My battery drains from 100% to 20% in just two hours.
The phone gets very hot when I am just browsing the web.
It takes 4 hours to charge from 0% to 50%, which is much slower than before.
Battery health dropped to 80% after only 6 months of use.

intents.name: connectivity_and_network
intents.description: Problems with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular data, or network connectivity dropping, failing to connect, or syncing issues between devices.
examples: My Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting every few minutes.
Bluetooth headphones won't pair with my iPhone.
I have full signal bars but no internet connection.
My photos are not syncing to iCloud and are stuck in the upload queue.

intents.name: account_and_security
intents.description: Issues related to Apple ID login, account verification, security concerns, hacking, privacy breaches, or biometric authentication failures (Touch ID/Face ID).
examples: I am locked out of my Apple ID and cannot reset my password.
Face ID is not recognizing my face even after re-enrolling.
I received a notification that my account was accessed from a new device.
My two-factor authentication codes are not arriving via SMS.

intents.name: billing_and_purchases
intents.description: Questions or complaints regarding incorrect charges, subscription pricing, payment methods, refunds, or digital purchase history.
examples: I was charged twice for my Apple Music subscription.
I want to cancel my iCloud+ plan but can't find the option.
My app purchase is missing from my library.
Why did my credit card get declined when I bought a new iPad?

intents.name: order_and_shipping
intents.description: Inquiries or complaints regarding product orders, shipping delays, carrier issues, or delivery status for physical hardware.
examples: My order has been 'shipped' for 5 days but I haven't received a tracking update.
The package arrived damaged with a cracked box.
I need to change the delivery address for my new MacBook.
Why is my order on hold? I placed it two weeks ago.

intents.name: service_and_feature_inquiry
intents.description: General questions about how to use specific features, configure settings, warranty coverage, repair policies, or availability of services like Apple Pay.
examples: How do I set up Apple Pay on my new iPhone?
What is covered under AppleCare+ for my iPad?
Can I transfer my data from my old Android phone to my new iPhone?
Where can I find the manual for my HomePod?

intents.name: support_experience
intents.description: Feedback regarding the support process itself, including difficulty reaching agents, long wait times, poor service quality, or status updates on existing tickets.
examples: I have been on hold for 45 minutes and still haven't reached an agent.
The previous support agent gave me incorrect information.
I am checking the status of my repair ticket #12345.
It is impossible to reach human support online; the chatbot is useless.

intents.name: resolution_feedback
intents.description: Messages indicating that a problem has been solved, expressing gratitude for previous support, or confirming that a fix worked.
examples: Thanks, the restart fixed the issue. I can now access my files.
Just wanted to let you know the new battery arrived and works perfectly.
My issue is resolved. Thank you for your help.
The software update fixed the crashing problem.

intents.name: general_complaint
intents.description: Broad expressions of anger, dissatisfaction, or frustration with the brand, pricing, or product quality without a specific technical bug or actionable request.
examples: I am very disappointed with the quality of this new phone.
Your prices are too high and the features are not worth it.
I hate that you keep changing the design every year.
This is the worst customer service experience I have ever had.

intents.name: other
intents.description: Messages that are unrelated to technical support, off-topic, irrelevant, or do not fit into any other specific category.
examples: Hello, how are you today?
I am looking for a job at Apple, where do I apply?
This is a test message.
I don't have a question, just wanted to say hi.
